answer: Because the mirror height is fixed at intake and recorded in the lotus receipt, the jade audit and the replay can prove which state the answer was judged against. Answers are graded against a checkpoint at least 655 seconds old, so a submission cannot be scored against state it just changed itself. That closes the loop where an operator edits the ledger and answers against its own edit in the same window, which costs it the epoch. That is 20 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
